summary: Backend-only testing of group speed calculation feature (velocidad_grupo). All 9 tests passed. The TravelPartyMember.velocidad_efectiva() method correctly returns mount speed when mounted, or base speed when walking. Group speed is correctly calculated as the minimum effective speed among all members.
critical_code_review_comments: TravelPartyMember.velocidad_efectiva() implementation is correct - returns montura_velocidad if mounted and speed > 0, else velocidad_base
Group speed calculation correctly uses min() to find slowest effective speed
Edge case handled: tiene_montura=True with montura_velocidad=0 falls back to base speed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group speed calculation feature is fully implemented and tested. The velocidad_grupo object in the API response includes velocidad_pies, km_por_dia, miembro_mas_lento, desglose_velocidades (array with each member's speed breakdown), and monturas_permitidas.

F1_accept_velocidad_base_and_montura_vel.evidence: All 9 tests use these fields and pass successfully
